hook.head: Claude can read your files.
hook.vo: Claude can read your files. Here are three ways to use that.

tips.vo: Upload your menu or price list as a PDF, and ask for five Instagram captions based on it. Real prices, real items, no typing.
tips.head: PDF to captions.

msgs: Write 5 Instagram captions from this menu
1. Our pistachio latte is back. 22 riyals of pure joy.

tips.vo: Upload a spreadsheet of your sales, and ask which items sell best, and on which days. You get answers, not just numbers.
tips.head: Ask your spreadsheet.

msgs: Spanish latte. Fridays are your busiest day.

tips.vo: Something broke on your website? Screenshot the error, upload it, and ask Claude what it means, and how to fix it.
tips.head: Screenshot the error.

cta.head: Save this for later.
cta.vo: Save this for later... and follow Pixel and Co, for more.
